subject: Re: board deck
body:
Hi Priya -- yes. m038 puts it on the 18th, so counting back 2 days, I will have the board deck circulated by the 16th.

Grounding: "Confirming the quarterly board review is set for the 18th, 10:00am, in-person at the office." (m038) and your own "Can you have the board deck finished and circulated two days before the board review?" (m040).
evidence: Confirming the quarterly board review is set for the 18th, 10:00am, in-person at the office.
offset '2 days before the board review' and the subject 'board deck' come from m040; the 18 comes from m038 ('board review' scheduled there); 18 - 2 = 16
